Synthetic test fixtures (0.5 s, 440 Hz sine, mono, 44.1 kHz), generated for this repository:

- `tone-44k1-mono.wav`: 16-bit PCM, written by a Python script
- `tone-44k1-mono.flac`: `flac`
- `tone-44k1-mono.mp3`: `lame -b 96`
- `tone-44k1-mono.m4a`: `afconvert -f m4af -d aac` (AAC-LC)

They contain no third-party material.
